name: Octree Raycasting with Refraction and Reflection
aliases: CUDA Octree Raycasting with Refraction and Reflection
definition: A GPU-based volume rendering technique that traverses an octree using CUDA kernels to compute ray-surface intersections, handling refraction and reflection recursively to simulate transparent and reflective materials.
summary: A GPU-based volume rendering technique that recursively computes refraction and reflection to simulate transparent and reflective materials, extending basic octree raycasting.
